kb-search.description: Knowledge base search server - FTS5, semantic search, tag cloud, related entries

observations: No financial data MCP servers installed

Adding new servers requires only editing .mcp.json

section_2_mcp_server_code_patterns.pattern_summary: Uses FastMCP for declarative tool registration with @mcp.tool() decorator. SQLite backend with WAL mode. Each tool is a function that returns dict/list[dict]. Server runs via mcp.run().

key_code_snippets.initialization:
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('kb-search')
key_code_snippets.db_connection:
def _db():
    db = sqlite3.connect(str(DB_PATH))
    db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL')
    return db

tools_exposed.name: kb_search
tools_exposed.description: FTS5 full-text search with BM25 ranking

tools_exposed.name: kb_get
tools_exposed.description: Get specific entry by ID with tags and relationships

tools_exposed.name: kb_related
tools_exposed.description: Find related entries via builds_on chains and shared tags

design_notes: All tools return plain dicts/lists - FastMCP handles JSON serialization
Error handling returns {'error': msg} dicts rather than raising exceptions
Semantic search gracefully degrades if lancedb not installed
Database connection is per-request (no connection pooling needed for MCP)

common_pattern.structure: Each method has METHOD_ID, METHOD_NAME constants, a run(query) function, and __main__ CLI entry point
common_pattern.output_format: Standardized JSON: {method_id, method_name, query, results: [], metadata: {duration_seconds, sources_count, data_points, ...}}
common_pattern.http_pattern: urllib.request with User-Agent header, timeout, error handling for HTTPError/URLError/OSError
common_pattern.caching: Optional request_cache integration via try/except ImportError fallback
common_pattern.cli_pattern: if __name__ == '__main__': sys.argv[1] as query, json.dumps to stdout

method_websearch_DG0001.approach: Multi-query search: generates 3-5 query variants, searches DuckDuckGo for each, deduplicates by URL
method_websearch_DG0001.key_pattern: Query variant generation for broader coverage

method_hackernews_DG0005.approach: Dual-source: Algolia HN search API + Firebase HN top stories API
method_hackernews_DG0005.key_pattern: _api_get() helper with cache integration, error dicts for failed requests

method_guardian_DG0006.approach: Guardian Content API with DuckDuckGo site-scoped fallback
method_guardian_DG0006.key_pattern: Graceful degradation: API fails -> DDG site:theguardian.com fallback

method_hybrid_DG0004.approach: Parallel execution of all methods (web, wikipedia, arxiv, openalex, wikidata) via ThreadPoolExecutor, cross-source corroboration scoring, TF-IDF deduplication
key_patterns: Source credibility tiers: academic (1.5x) > encyclopedia (1.2x) > structured_knowledge (1.1x) > web (1.0x)
Cross-reference via keyword overlap (>=4 keywords) and URL matching
Weighted scoring combining credibility and corroboration

current_state.observation: Heavily weighted toward utility/infrastructure (27 utility) vs domain-output (8 analysis, 16 data-collection). Only 2 API tools despite 44 cataloged sources.

top_5_recommendations.item: Adopt LightRAG for knowledge graph retrieval

key_findings.key_insight: The biggest gap is the ratio of domain-output tools to coordination tools. Adding 2-3 financial MCP servers to .mcp.json would instantly transform capability from 'can research topics' to 'can analyze stocks with real financial data' in hours.

sop_014_simultaneous_project_management.purpose: Enables central commander to run 2-5 simultaneous projects with hub-and-spoke monitoring

key_concepts.project_decomposition: Parse user request into distinct project objectives, assign team groups (Group-{LETTER}-{purpose}), isolate output paths

scaling_tiers.medium_8_16: 2-3 projects, 4-8 teams, monitor at team level
scaling_tiers.large_16_30: 3-5 projects, 6-10 teams, monitor at project level with project leads

key_concepts.resource_rebalancing: Completed group's agents reassigned to lagging projects
key_concepts.file_isolation: No two agents from different project groups write to same file (except append-only JSONL)

sop_014_simultaneous_project_management.relevance_to_5_sessions: This SOP defines how to run multi-project operations. For 5 sessions, each session can be a project group with isolated output paths.

sop_022_team_sizing.purpose: Evidence-based team sizing from 28 sessions, 132 agent instances

sizing_rules.SIZE_01_solo: 1 agent for independent research. 4.0 artifacts/agent. ~0% overhead.
sizing_rules.SIZE_02_small: 3 agents for focused tool building. 1.0 artifacts/agent. ~5% overhead.
sizing_rules.SIZE_04_large: 9-12 agents for parallel research streams. 20-25% overhead. Must use lead-sub pattern.
sizing_rules.SIZE_05_avoid: 15+ agents: 89% efficiency loss. Only for unique multi-team capabilities.

overview.name: LightRAG

core_approach.description: Graph-enhanced RAG combining knowledge graphs with vector retrieval
key_innovations: Dual-level retrieval: specific entity queries + abstract conceptual queries

performance_claims.quality_improvement: Up to 86.4% better in complex domains (e.g., legal)

findings.applicability_to_our_kb: HIGH. Our 40+ KB entries with builds_on chains form a natural graph. LightRAG could replace FTS5/TF-IDF with graph-aware retrieval understanding entity relationships (tools -> APIs -> data sources -> picks).

claude_agent_sdk.search_query: Claude Agent SDK examples programmatic orchestration

findings.core_philosophy: Designed to give agents a computer, not just a prompt. Production-grade runtime with terminal, file system, and web access.

subagent_orchestration.description: Define subagents programmatically in ClaudeAgentOptions. Orchestrator uses built-in Task tool to invoke subagents.
subagent_orchestration.model_mixing: Different models per subagent (e.g., Opus orchestrator + Sonnet workers for cost optimization)

agent_teams.description: Coordinate multiple Claude Code instances. One team lead coordinates, teammates work independently in own context windows.
agent_teams.vs_subagents: Use subagents for quick focused workers; use agent teams when teammates need to share findings and coordinate

programmatic_tool_calling.description: Claude writes code that calls multiple tools, processes outputs, and controls what enters its context window
programmatic_tool_calling.benefit: Reduces API round-trips by batching tool calls in code

built_in_subagent_types.explore: Fast, read-only subagent for codebase search
built_in_subagent_types.plan: Research-focused subagent for context gathering and planning

claude_flow.description: Open-source orchestration framework for running multiple Claude agents in coordinated workflows

findings.relevance_to_sessions: We are already running inside this SDK. Key opportunities: (1) Package workflows as Agent Skills, (2) Use subagent spawning instead of custom coordination, (3) Leverage built-in Explore/Plan subagents.

critical_architecture_decisions.decision: MCP-first vs Script-first for financial data
critical_architecture_decisions.recommendation: MCP-first. Add existing MCP servers (Alpha Vantage official, EdgarTools, Yahoo Finance) to .mcp.json. Only build custom method_*.py scripts for APIs without MCP servers (FRED, Finnhub).
critical_architecture_decisions.rationale: MCP servers provide instant tool access without code. EdgarTools MCP server is a game-changer - provides full SEC EDGAR access including AI skills for Claude.

critical_architecture_decisions.decision: Which MCP servers to add in Session 1
recommendation: Alpha Vantage (official, free key, Progressive Tool Discovery)
EdgarTools (free, no key, full SEC filings, has MCP server built-in)
Yahoo Finance / StockFlow (no auth needed, real-time data)

critical_architecture_decisions.recommendation: Session 3 or later. Requires indexing pipeline setup. Current FTS5 + semantic search via kb-search MCP server is functional. LightRAG is an enhancement, not a blocker.
Session 2. Package market-research-pick workflow as .skill.md file. Low effort, high reuse value.

critical_architecture_decisions.decision: Custom coordination vs Agent SDK built-ins
critical_architecture_decisions.recommendation: Evaluate in Session 4. Our custom coordination (coordinator_hub.py, multi_team_runner.py) works. Agent SDK's subagent spawning and Claude Flow are alternatives worth comparing but not urgent to migrate.
